mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND points > 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(points)), 0) FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND points < 0

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, COALESCE(a.balance, 0) AS balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.points > 0 THEN t.points END), 0) AS total_earned, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.points < 0 THEN -t.points END), 0) AS total_spent, MAX(t.create_time) AS last_change_time FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN point_account a ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN point_transaction t ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, a.balance ORDER BY last_change_time DESC NULLS LAST
